replies.body: I agree with your reasoning. It's really my favorite part of the server as a whole. That one aspect alone implicates depth and extraordinary gameplay that can be enjoyed by people of all ages, suiting both those young and old for the optimal community and variety. Honestly this is one of the only things keeping Avicus in a premium state and thankful it's an extremely strong and well developed piece of the Avicus puzzle, basically keeping this server alive. Overall, I do support your point.
